issues.problem: The documented StatusMaps feed is getTrainsData, not getTrainStatus?train_num=1. The shown endpoint and plain JSON response schema appear fabricated; the real browser feed returns an opaque/encrypted payload rather than that object.
issues.suggestion: Use https://maps.amtrak.com/services/MapDataService/trains/getTrainsData and explain that its unsupported payload must be decoded/decrypted and filtered client-side.

issues.problem: AniList currently warns that the API is degraded and temporarily limited to 30 requests per minute, so the unconditional 90 requests/minute claim is not current.
issues.suggestion: State that the normal documented limit is 90 requests/minute but the current degraded-state limit is 30 requests/minute; update the same claim in pricing.free_tier_limits.

issues.problem: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 was retired from the Claude API on June 15, 2026, so this request now fails.
